Paid Network is a decentralized oracle network that supplies external data to smart contracts. Paid Network relies on a decentralized network of data providers rather than a single intermediary.

BitMart is a centralized cryptocurrency exchange that matches trades on its own platform. BitMart therefore relies on a central operator, which conflicts with the intermediary-free model of DeFi.
